title: Hearing on safety conditions in NYC homeless shelters
summary: The Council's General Welfare Committee held an oversight hearing on safety in the city's homeless shelter system, which housed about 85,066 people on an average night in 2026. The hearing also examined two bills: one requiring the Department of Homeless Services to report on placements of families with children, and another requiring reporting on crime statistics in shelters. Topics covered included unsafe building conditions, violence and theft, and staffing shortages among shelter providers.
